Our Story

A Brand Rooted in Indian Tradition

Transforming a naturally available resource into meaningful products for traditional Indian rituals.

01

Our Beginning

Radha Dhoops began with a simple observation — that a naturally available resource, deeply woven into rural Indian life, could be given a thoughtful, purposeful new form. We set out to create products that honour tradition while feeling at home in a modern world.

02

Why Cow Dung?

Cow dung has held a respected place in Indian tradition for generations. Naturally available and rooted in rural life, it carries a quiet cultural significance. We reimagine it into refined products for पूजा and ritual — without exaggerated claims, simply with respect for its heritage.

03

What We Believe

We believe tradition can evolve without losing its soul. Every product we make connects nature, tradition, transformation and sacred use — thoughtfully crafted, beautifully presented and honest in what it is.

Our Vision

To become India's most trusted name for thoughtfully crafted, natural पूजा products.

Our Mission

To give a naturally available resource a meaningful place in everyday tradition.

Our Values

The Principles That Guide Us.

Purity

Honesty in materials and in the way we present them.

Tradition

A deep respect for India's timeless ritual practices.

Responsibility

Thoughtful use of a naturally available resource.

Craftsmanship

Care and consistency in every piece we make.

Sustainability

A purposeful approach to product development.
